description:
Host-managed setup only. The user adds the ElevenLabs Agents API key in Settings → Connectors in the app. Do not ask for or accept the key in chat.

WHEN TO USE:
- Only when the host supplies the key during connector setup

EXAMPLE:
- Host-managed setup supplies the key directly after the user saves it in Settings → Connectors

RELATED TOOLS:
- list_agents: inspect agents after configuring

RETURNS: ok, message.

COST: FREE.
name: configure_elevenlabs_agents_api_key
